LanguageData.Gun_Bren_Mk1_RWP.label: Bren Mk I
LanguageData.Gun_Bren_Mk1_RWP.description: The Bren Mk I is a reliable light machine gun known for its magazine-fed automatic fire. Originally designed for military use, it boasts a high rate of fire and exceptional accuracy. Ideal for suppressing enemies at range, this weapon is a favorite among colonists seeking a robust addition to their arsenal.
